## Checklist · 自检清单

- [ ] One project only, in the correct section, sorted by maturity then name.
- [ ] **License** tag (`🟢🟡🔴`) added and matches the code's own declaration.
- [ ] **Maturity** tag (`⭐🧪👀`) added.
- [ ] Active in the last ~6 months, or a de-facto standard.
- [ ] Description is one neutral sentence about *which layer it fits and what problem it solves*.
- [ ] First-party source (not a fork/mirror/aggregator).
